verdict.rationale: Deel's docs explicitly market and support hiring via EOR and global payroll across 150+ countries, with API/MCP tooling (contracts, EOR cost comparisons, payroll) confirming this is a first-class capability rather than just marketing copy. Community feedback raises operational/trust concerns (customer service, workflow rigidity, wallet terms) but does not concretely contradict that EOR/global payroll hiring itself works. Missing for 10: independent case studies or hands-on verification of actual compliant EOR outcomes across countries.
